title: Chatham reports cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under four
friendlyTitle: AI helps experts check trades much faster
summary: Chatham Financial says a Codex-built application gathers transaction evidence, compares key terms and flags discrepancies, reducing early trade-validation reviews from about 30 minutes to under four. The firm is comparing results with experienced reviewers before expanding the automation.
friendlySummary: Chatham Financial built a tool that collects evidence and checks trade details. The company says an early review now takes under four minutes instead of about 30.
whyItMatters: This is a useful pattern for high-stakes office work: automate evidence gathering and structured comparison while keeping expert review and auditability. The reported time saving is meaningful, but it is a company case study rather than an independent evaluation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can remove slow preparation work while people still review important financial decisions. The company is testing the tool against experienced staff before using it more widely.
